author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest Foundlings trailer for this upcoming RPG. Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Forge spells by combining conduits, trade favours with lords and serfs, watch the motions of the planets and keep your Humours in check as you help them find their purpose. Foundlings will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Foundlings - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Drainer, a bullet hell action arena shooter developed by Firelime. Players will take the heart of a ruthless tyrant to ensure he pays for his transgressions. Overcome challenges, monitor your health, and seek out the tyrant. Drainer is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now for PC (Steam).
title: Drainer - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for The Suspense, a psychological horror game developed by M8 Workshop. Players will traverse an alternative future to brave the hardships of an unforgiving world. Overcome challenges, endure the torture, and survive at all costs. The Suspense is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: The Suspense - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Emissary One, a dungeon crawler exploration game developed by Rone Vine. Players will explore abstract areas to complete tasks, adapt to changing weather, and assume the role of entities to invade other players' games. Emissary One is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Emissary One - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the characters and get a peek at gameplay from Midnight Souls in this trailer for the upcoming 2D adventure game. Midnight Souls is a mysterious 2D adventure game, where you take on the role of a teenager who travels to an unfamiliar town for a date with a girl he met online. What starts as a romantic evening threatens to turn into a genuine nightmare. Along the way, the protagonist will have to learn to overcome fear and self-doubt, make new friends, and take care of his cat, Charlie. Midnight Souls will be available on PC in 2027. A playtest is out now on Steam.
title: Midnight Souls - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Weed Out, a bullet heaven roguelike developed by QuokkaPlay. Players will take on dangerous plants that have gone awry. Dispatch over 190 unique plant-based enemies, complete challenges, and dish out combos. Weed Out is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Weed Out - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Teaser Trailer for B.L.U.E. NOVA, an upcoming third-person PvE shooter developed by GungHo Online Entertainment. Players will link up in 30-player lobbies to join forces on the battlefield against an AI army. Destroy Barrier Towers, customize a hero, and connect with others through R.I.N.G. to take out the Master Tower. B.L.U.E. NOVA is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#BlueNova #Gaming #IGN
title: B.L.U.E. NOVA - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a peek at gameplay and the catastrophic mischief you can get into in this trailer for Cat Secretary, an upcoming job simulator adventure game. Cat Secretary will be available on PC on November 4, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!
title: Cat Secretary - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into what to expect with the Cities: Skylines 2 expansion pass 2 in this latest video for the city-building game. Check it out to learn more about the Park Adventures expansion, including the Downtown Market set. The Downtown Market Set introduces a vibrant social hub featuring food trucks and a new Scottish-inspired map, while the upcoming Park Adventures expansion focuses on customizing diverse outdoor spaces like parks, zoos, and amusement parks. The Downtown Market set instantly unlocks with the purchase of the Cities: Skylines 2 expansion pass 2.
title: Cities: Skylines 2 - Official Expansion Pass 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the ‘Catching Just Feel Right’ Live-Action Trailer for Aniimo, a free-to-play creature-collecting open-world game developed by Pawprint Studio. Players will hear the call to thrill and adventure to catch Aniimo, explore a vibrant open world, and harness new abilities along the way. Aniimo is launching on September 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with a release on iOS and Android on September 23.
title: Aniimo - Official ‘Catching Just Feel Right’ Live-Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Depths of the Damned Update Reveal Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide, a first-person class-based action shooter developed by Fatshark. Players can soon take on the trials and tribulations of an incoming update that brings the fight to the Spillway. Arm up with six new weapons and take on the new boss, The Prophet of Decay. The Depths of the Damned Update for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is launching on September 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Official Depths of the Damned Update Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay from Eldritch Escape in this latest trailer for the upcoming Lovecraftian extraction bullet heaven game, where Earth has been consumed by an eldritch god. In Eldritch Escape, build a customizable squad, battle endless horrors, extract resources, and search for a way out of the void. Eldritch Escape will be available on PC. A new open playtest is available now.
title: Eldritch Escape - Official New Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Voxotron trailer for this psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant in Voxotron. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends. Voxotron will be available on PC (Steam). A demo is out now.
title: Voxotron - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Old Town Roads DLC Trailer for Bus Bound, a bus management simulation game developed by Stillalive Studios. Players can check out the countryside with the new Old Town Roads DLC, featuring two new districts, challenges from dirt roads to on-road events, and the new Horizon “Chamois” Minibus to take along the route. The Old Town Roads DLC for Bus Bound is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Bus Bound - Official Old Town Roads DLC Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton, a bullet hell action battle royale developed by Poncle. Players will master movement around the play space with iconic characters from Jujutsu Kaisen to leverage powerful abilities. Take on waves of enemies in Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Chivalware, a fast-paced action roguelite developed by Regal Pigeon. Players will evade incoming attacks, excel in grid-based combat, and embody the coveted role of Disk Knight to take out the Mad King. Chivalware is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Chivalware - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Civilization 7 trailer for a breakdown of the Hall of History Collection and what it brings to the strategy sim game. The Hall of History Collection features two new leaders: Elizabeth I and George Washington, along with three new civilizations: Babylon, Gauls, and England. 

Civilization 7 is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). The Hall of History Collection is out now.
title: Civilization 7 - Official Hall of History Collection Recap Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Closed Alpha 6 Overview Trailer for Gods, Death & Reapers, a hack-and-slash action RPG developed by Wolcen Studio. Players can get the rundown on key additions to the game, with Asgard arriving as a new map to the game. Double axe, permanent items, and more have been added to the Closed Alpha 6 for Gods, Death & Reapers, running from September 24 through September 28, with an Early Access release in February 2027 on PC (Steam).
title: Gods, Death & Reapers - Official Closed Alpha 6 Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Rollout Inline is out now in Steam Early Access. Check out the Rollout Inline early access launch trailer for this new aggressive inline game from solo developer ML Media. The Rollout Inline trailer showcases features like challenges and the game's progression system.
title: Rollout Inline - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Fright Train, a third-person survival horror game developed by WildArts Games. Players will take on the role of Doug Barker as a train is taken over by sinister forces and monsters from nightmares. Monitor the train's systems, dispatch enemies around every corner, and survive through the trek across Antartica at all costs. Fright Train is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Fright Train - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Wilderness Bound Launch Trailer for Minecraft, the hit creation adventure game developed by Mojang. Players can set off into the depths of the forest for an unforgettable adventure. Build outposts, craft new items, and explore life under the trees. Seek out adventure in Wilderness Bound for Minecraft, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, and PC.
title: Minecraft - Official Wilderness Bound Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The Gauls are available now in Civilization 7 as part of the Hall of History Collection DLC bundle. The Hall of History Collection DLC bundle features 2 leaders and 3 civilizations. Watch the latest Civilization 7 trailer to see the Gauls, a group of Celtic tribes known for their brilliant metalsmiths and fearless warriors.
title: Civilization 7 - Official Civ Tour: Gauls Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Apex Legends x Street Fighter 6 trailer as the fighting game arrives in the Outlands of the free-to-play battle royale game. In the Apex Legends VS Street Fighter 6 event, throw down in Wildcard with the fighting styles of Ryu, Chun-Li, Akuma, and Dhalsim, launch Hadokens and Shoryukens across a remixed Olympus. The event also allows you to suit up as Street Fighter 6 characters with 8 new Legend Skins, Street Fighter 6 Weapon Skins, and the Hadoken Mythic Universal Melee. 

Apex Legends is available now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via EA App, Epic Games Store and Steam. The Apex Legends VS Street Fighter 6 Event arrives on September 22, 2026.
title: Apex Legends - Official Apex Legends VS Street Fighter 6 Event Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Under The Hammer Heist Launch Trailer for Payday 2, the hit first-person co-op heist action game developed by Overkill. Players can now infiltrate the Pallisandro Dimora auction house to steal some of the world's most coveted art pieces. Wield a new shotgun, a hammer melee weapon, new masks, and more to get away with riches beyond comparison. The Hammer Heist is available now for Payday 2 on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Payday 2 - Official Under The Hammer Heist Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition announcement trailer for this strategy game, featuring all the DLC and new improvements, including updated visuals, full Japanese voiceover and text, over 50 newly playable minor factions, and more. Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition will be available on Xbox on PC, Steam, and Epic Games Store on October 13, 2026.
title: Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get ready to make the DreamHouse sparkle. Watch the latest PowerWash Simulator 2 trailer for the sim game as you take a journey to Barbie's Dreamhouse and clean it up in the upcoming Barbie Pack DLC. PowerWash Simulator 2 is available on Steam, Epic Games Store, Windows PC, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 5 Pro (PS5 Pro), and Nintendo Switch 2. The Barbie Pack for PowerWash Simulator 2 will be available in late 2026.
title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Official Barbie Pack Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Two Point Museum trailer to see what to expect with the Rides & Relic DLC for the management strategy game. Take on the role of Funfair Expert, and prepare to reopen the gates of Two Point County’s once-legendary amusement park, after a decades-long hiatus. 

In the Rides & Relic DLC, create your own personalized coasters across five unique themes, embark on expeditions to the abandoned Gearbox Fairgrounds, discover the new museum location: Riquetti Gardens, discover a new five-star story campaign, collect ten new mascots, curate over 15 Funfair exhibits, get new Gift Shop items, discover Funfair-themed items and decorations, landscape iwht new hedges, fences, and outdoor items, and enjoy a new range of utility items like the Helipad, Ticket Desk, benches, bins, and more. 

Two Point Museum is available now on PC, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. The Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics DLC will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStat
title: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Dune: Awakening, an open-world survival game developed by Funcom. Players will brave the dry deserts of Arrakis to explore a new standalone story within the Dune universe. Engage with the sandworms, craft gear, utilize Dune technology, and more to become a legend. Dune: Awakening is launching on September 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, with the game available now on PC (Steam).
title: Dune: Awakening - Official Game Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the PS5 Features Trailer for Control Resonant, the upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Remedy. Players will traverse an abstract New York beyond the walls of the FBC with unprecedented features courtesy of the PlayStation 5. Enjoy haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, 3D audio, and more during Dylan Faden's journey. Control Resonant is launching on September 24 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Mac, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Control Resonant - Official PS5 Features Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at Humblets in this new trailer for the upcoming cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. Humblets will be available on PC (Steam), Nintendo, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox, and PlayStation. A Kickstarter campaign is live now.

Support the Kickstarter here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/berrybite/humblets
title: Humblets - Official Kickstarter Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is available now on Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed Nintendo Switch 2 launch trailer as Crypto returns in this remake of the action game. In Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed, Crypto is back with a license to probe. The alien invader returns, groovier than ever. Experience the swinging ‘60s in all its chemical-induced glory and take revenge on the KGB for blowing up your mothership. You’ll have to form alliances with members of the very species you came to enslave.
title: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the V8 Power Pack Launch Trailer for Project Motor Racing, the hit racing simulation game developed by Giants Software. Players can get behind the wheel of three muscle cars that pack a punch to attain victory on any track. Check out the 2023 Ford Mustang AU, 2023 Chevrolet Camaro AU, 2022 Dodge Challenger, 2022 Ford Mustang, 2022 Chevrolet Camaro, 1970 Ford Mustang Boss 302, 1970 Plymouth Barracuda, 1970 AMC Javelin, and the iconic 1968 Chevrolet Camaro Z28. The V8 Power Pack for Project Motor Racing is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Project Motor Racing - Official V8 Power Pack Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Miniopolis announcement trailer for this upcoming resource-free city-building sandbox game, where you can build the way you want. Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Miniopolis will be available on PC (via Steam). A demo is coming soon.
title: Miniopolis - Official Announcement Trailer
